snippet.title: Feed the World - Cinematic trailer
snippet.description:
Start with one potato. Build a farming empire. Work towards one trillion meal portions.

Feed the World is a farming and automation game where a small patch of land grows into a bustling farm. Plant and harvest crops, cook meals, hire workers and put your machines to work.

Expand into long fields and busy production yards, explore your farm in first person, or take a break by the river for some fishing. Just keep an eye on the weather…

And then there’s Dizzle. Let’s just say the breeding programme has some unexpected results.

🌱 Find out more: https://feedtheworld.dev
🔔 Subscribe for development updates, gameplay and more questionable farming decisions.

What would you build first—and would you trust Dizzle near your livestock?

Captured in-game with cinematic cameras and edited progression.

#FeedTheWorld #FarmingGame #IndieGame
